title: La Diamond wins Drag Race Italia Season 2
summary: In the Grand Finale (IT-S02-E08), La Diamond, Aura Eternal, and Nehellenia lip-synced to Paola & Chiara's "Festival". La Diamond was crowned Drag Race Italia's second Drag Superstar, with Aura Eternal and Nehellenia as runners-up.

title: Narciso: Italia Season 2's first Porkchop
summary: Narciso was the first contestant eliminated on Drag Race Italia season 2 (IT-S02-E01), losing the lip sync to "La bambola" against Panthera Virus.
